==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{l|en|negociation}} {{qualifier|obsolete}}

===Etymology===
Borrowed from {{bor|en|frm|négociation}}, or from {{bor|en|la|negotiatio||the carrying on of business, a wholesale business}}, from {{m|la|negotiari||to carry on business}}. {{surf|en|negotiate|-ion}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/nɪˌɡəʊ.ʃiˈeɪ.ʃən/|/nɪˌɡəʊ.siˈeɪ.ʃən/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/nɪˌɡoʊ.ʃiˈeɪ.ʃən/|/nəˌɡoʊ.ʃiˈeɪ.ʃən/|/nɪˌɡoʊ.siˈeɪ.ʃən/|/nəˌɡoʊ.siˈeɪ.ʃən/|a=GA,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-negotiation.ogg|a=Southern California}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Simplificationalizer-negotiation.wav|a=New Jersey}}
* {{hyph|en|ne|go|ti|a|tion}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪʃən|s=5}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# The process of achieving [[agreement]] through [[discussion]].
#: {{ux|en|The specifics of the contract are still under '''negotiation'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|The two parties entered into '''negotiations''' about the merger.}}
